data.name: DIY Simulator
data.detailed_description:
DIY Simulator is teaching everyone how to build DIY (DO IT YOURSELF) objects like electric skateboards, drones, power banks, portable speakers, wireless chargers and many more.

  • By having a day and night cycle, you need to sleep because if you get tired, you cannot work.
  • The assembly system (building system) is user-friendly, you just need to go to the garage and interact with the workbench and a simple menu will appear. From that menu, you can choose what object to build, you can see the parts needed and the final cost (if you buy the parts from the store).
  • In the bedroom, you can find a computer that has a few applications:
    • File Manager - is used for reading and showing texts and images
    • Browser - is used to buy parts
    • Mail - is used to see orders/quests
    • Bank - is used to see transactions and balance
    • 3D Printer - is used to write to USB stick models for the printer
  • The parts will arrive after 1 to 3 days in a box, at his mailbox. Sending an object (or more) to the owner needs to be done in the same way and will be done at the mailbox, but the boxes will be picked when the courier comes. Later in the game, you can build your own car (from parts) and you can go and pick and/or ship the packages if you don't want to wait.
  • Sleeping is not the only thing you need to do, you also need to drink, eat and to go to the toilet.
  • Buying food and water can be made from the local market.
  • Low on money? No problem, you can find used or not working parts/objects at the traders from the scrap yard and you can get the good parts and create a good and new object.
  • Be careful, outside the village are wild animals like wolves and boars. The safest way is to go with your car, or if you don't have one, just ..don't go! They can kill you, or damage your car.
  • By using your mobile phone, you can see your orders, emails, and bank account.
  • You can use the ATM from the market to withdraw or deposit money.

reviews.review:
Ok my review for other players, Honest review and will try to be fair.

Only played around 30 minutes or so of this game but that was enough for me to get a refund and i will explain why  but first try to say some good points i noticed with game

pro's
Good  idea and some realism to game mechanics
Im sure there are other good things but from the short time i played that  all i noticed

Cons
Day night cycle far too quick

I could only sleep during day and not night, Therefor when trying to do anything was always dark  and hard to see because when ever i woke up was afternoon and night time came too quick

Always get tired too quickly, think this must be linked with night cycle coming to quick, I slept around 4-5 times in the space of 30 minutes (real time) 

Always need drink and eat, Not as often as sleeping  but still far too much

Stuff gets put into a bag when buying food/water and is so fiddly trying to empty to actually eat or drink your items,  needs an option on the bag to select empty goods

Vehicle seems to have no brakes or atleast takes a lifetime to stop

Vehicle controls are fiddly to start and stop engine

Also fiddly to stick usb stick into pc/3d printer

Last one from me but im sure there is more issues  if I played longer is when your character needs to eat or drink or do anything
he keeps saying for example "I need to eat"  every few seconds, not counted exact time but I would say between 3-5 seconds and this gets very annoying.
Once my character tells me he is thirsty  I know, dont need reminding every few seconds,  need to  increase time on this to every 5 minutes  or maybe 3 minutes at minimum.

This last issue was the last straw for me and what made me get refund,  Trying to record a youtube series on this game with constant "I need to eat  or I need to drink" etc just isnt very good  for vidoes and the constant night time thing.

May  suggestion to people is dont buy yet  wait untill another update to see if these things are fixed  but may even take a few updates.
Really good idea for the game but the execution of the game just isnt there yet, I know ealry access but I just feel even for that  some basics things could of been implemented to the game first  to atleats make it enjoyable to play instead of just thinking I want to refund this game and for the space of around 30 minutes thats bad to have as a game  for someone  wanted to refund game with such short time played.

Im not writting off the game totally becasue like i said maybe with a few updates it will be a good game to play but as of now
STAY AWAY

I would rate this game 3/10 from current state

Really hope devs see this and look at this as a way to improve and take my negative thoughts and make the game better, really want to see this improve alot and maybe i will buy again.

One game that comes to mind which is totally different is DAYZ, that was early acess for long tiem but when that came out yes full of bugs and issues but was fun to play for most part.

This game just isnt fun to play and thats the key factor with games,  if they have issues which all games do have atleast  make it fun becasue with the issues i stated above it really isnt fun
